title: 21.20. Hetuduka, Saṅkiliṭṭhattika
note: Pāli only: every English translation of the Abhidhamma is still under copyright, so no English can be shown yet. A free translation will be added if one becomes available.

verses.t: Nahetuṁ nasaṅkiliṭṭhasaṅkilesikaṁ dhammaṁ paccayā hetu saṅkiliṭṭhasaṅkilesiko dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. (Saṅkhittaṁ.) Hetuyā tīṇi …pe… avigate tīṇi.
Nahetuṁ naasaṅkiliṭṭhasaṅkilesikaṁ dhammaṁ paṭicca nahetu asaṅkiliṭṭhasaṅkilesiko dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. (Saṅkhittaṁ.) Hetuyā tīṇi, adhipatiyā tīṇi …pe… avigate tīṇi.
Nahetuṁ naasaṅkiliṭṭhaasaṅkilesikaṁ dhammaṁ paccayā hetu asaṅkiliṭṭhaasaṅkilesiko dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. (Saṅkhittaṁ.) Hetuyā tīṇi …pe… avigate tīṇi.
